title: Retail Installment Contracts Tier Rate Sheet: Score Bands, APR, Term and Amount Financed
content:
Retail Installment Contracts are bought from dealers at one of six credit tiers. The tier is the one whose Harborline score band contains the borrower's Harborline score at origination, and each tier sets the annual percentage rate, scheduled term and amount financed a contract of that tier may carry. Rates are simple interest.

## Tier assignment

| Tier | Harborline score band (inclusive) | Prior auto repossession accepted | Discharged bankruptcy accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 400 to 479 | yes | yes |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 480 to 519 | yes | yes |
| Tier 4 Standard | 520 to 559 | yes | yes |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 560 to 599 | no | yes |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 600 to 639 | no | no |
| Tier 1 Select | 640 to 850 | no | no |

## Rate, term and amount by tier

| Tier | Lowest APR | Highest APR | Shortest term | Longest term | Smallest amount financed (USD) | Largest amount financed (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 24.99% | 29.99% | 24 months | 48 months | 5000.00 | 14000.00 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 21.99% | 27.49% | 24 months | 54 months | 5000.00 | 18000.00 |
| Tier 4 Standard | 18.99% | 24.99% | 24 months | 60 months | 5000.00 | 22500.00 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 15.99% | 21.99% | 24 months | 66 months | 5000.00 | 27500.00 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 12.49% | 18.49% | 24 months | 72 months | 5000.00 | 32500.00 |
| Tier 1 Select | 8.99% | 14.99% | 24 months | 75 months | 5000.00 | 40000.00 |

The amount financed includes taxes, fees and financed add-on products. The term is the number of scheduled monthly installments.

## State APR ceilings (every tier)

The booked APR is also never above the ceiling the company books for the contract state, the borrower's state at signing whose law governs the contract:

| Contract state | AR | CT | MD | NY | PA | WV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ceiling | 17.0% | 19.0% | 24.0% | 25.0% | 18.0% | 18.0% |

A state not on this schedule uses the tier's highest APR alone.

## Funding stipulation deadline (every tier)

The dealer must clear every funding stipulation within 30 calendar days after the contract date; a contract still pending funding after that is unwound.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical cases)

- A Tier 4 Standard contract signed in Maryland may carry at most 24.0%, the lower of the tier's 24.99% and the Maryland ceiling.
- A Tier 1 Select contract signed in New York may carry up to 14.99%; the 25.0% New York ceiling is above the tier's highest rate and does not bind.
- A Tier 6 Fresh Start contract signed in Arkansas meets a 17.0% ceiling that lies below the tier's lowest APR of 24.99%, so no rate inside the tier band satisfies both limits.
